name: a reordered row keeps its typed value, its focus and its scroll

steps.run: const root = document.querySelector('todo-list').shadowRoot; const input = root.querySelectorAll('input')[2]; input.focus(); input.value = 'sourdough'; root.querySelectorAll('.scroller')[2].scrollTop = 50; window.typed = input
document.querySelector('todo-list').setAttribute('items', JSON.stringify([{ id: 3, text: 'bread' }, { id: 1, text: 'milk' }, { id: 2, text: 'eggs' }]))
